name: involuntary_employment_steals_attacks_and_pays_with_the_treasure
notes: Printed: 'Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Create a Treasure token.' Seat 1's 3/3 Ogre starts tapped. Seat 0 casts Involuntary Employment on it: seat 0 controls it, it is untapped and has haste, so it attacks seat 1 this turn (20 -> 17). Seat 0's Treasure then pays Giant Growth on it (no other mana). On seat 1's turn the Ogre is back under seat 1's control.
